name: SKYCRAFTERS 🎮 🖱 [26.2]
description:
Skycrafters is a crossplay Minecraft network where Java and Bedrock players build side by side. Hosted in an Australian datacenter, it's tuned for low ping across OCE, AU, and Asia.

A GROWING NETWORK

Skyblock is where it starts. Survival is coming soon, with more on the way — one hub, one account, everything connected.

CROSSPLAY, DONE RIGHT

Full Java + Bedrock support, so you and your friends can play together on any device. Pushing optimisations for Bedrock that will make us stand out above other crossplay servers!

CONNECT

Java: skycraftersmc.net

Bedrock: play.skycraftersmc.net, port 19132

Website: www.skycraftersmc.net

Vote daily for SkyBux and help us climb the list!
